errors.evidence: The largest sector in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart is 'industry' (yellow), not 'other services' (brown). The description incorrectly assigns the color blue to 'other services' instead of 'construction'.
The 'industry' sector in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart is 61% (19.0 млн.), not 12% (3.7 млн.). The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'other services' to 'industry'.
In the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart, 'industry' is 51% (80.2 млн.), not 'other services'. The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'industry' to 'other services'.
In the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart, 'other services' is 21% (33.0 млн.), not 'trade'. The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'other services' to 'trade'.
In the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart, 'trade' is 19% (29.5 млн.), not 'industry'. The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'trade' to 'industry'.
In the 'TURNOVER' chart, 'industry' is 31% (9.8 трилиона), not 'trade'. The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'industry' to 'trade'.
In the 'TURNOVER' chart, 'trade' is 31% (9.9 трилиона), not 'industry'. The description incorrectly assigns the percentage and value of 'trade' to 'industry'.
The color for 'construction' is blue, not dark blue. The description adds an unnecessary qualifier.
The description does not explicitly state that the sectors are not visually ordered by size.
